hooks.text: 每局先选一名决定全局思路的英雄和两个限定牌池的阵营，再购买升级单位、锁牌并装配关键道具。
hooks.excerpt: At the start of every run, choose one Hero (with a passive power that shapes your whole plan) and two Clans (which decide what cards you’ll play). That’s your squad. Spend gold to buy and upgrade units, freeze must-haves, and slap on game-changing items.
hooks.label: 证据原文片段

hooks.text: 用短局异步对战冲击月度重置的排位赛季，并在每日“山丘之王”中争夺单局最高声望。
hooks.excerpt: Ranked is where it counts: win runs, rank up, climb the leaderboard, and chase that sweet Ultimate Slacker title which is reset each month with a fresh season! Or claim the crown in our daily King of the Hill mode by scoring the highest Reputation in a single run.
hooks.label: 证据原文片段

hooks.text: 把厕纸、慢炖锅等超市日用品变成战斗单位，并围绕它们组合出荒诞联动。
hooks.excerpt: Toilet paper. Slow cooker. You name it. If it’s on the shelf, it’s ready for battle. We turned everyday store products into EPIC UNITS ! And they’ve got some seriously crazy synergies .
